name: Sockfoot the Garden Tabby
description: Sockfoot is a grey tabby with a white bib and four white paws like socks. At first light he strolls the path, sniffs the flowers, then naps on warm stones. A cat coin priced in NVDAx. Not affiliated with NVIDIA Corporation or StonkFun. No intrinsic value; not financial advice.
look: A slim dark-grey tabby shorthair house cat with a white chin and muzzle, a white bib and four white paws that look like socks, and a long striped grey tail held up, strolling a garden path. It wears nothing; the 'socks' are only its white fur.
